tone: Grounded, system-neutral fantasy with occasional unusual or memorable details.

appearances.text: Broad-shouldered and steady-looking, with sun-browned skin and short, practical hair.
Carefully groomed and immaculately dressed, with every fastening polished and every crease deliberate.
Earth-stained and practical, with rough nails, sun-faded hair, and clothing repaired more often than replaced.
Graceful but faintly uncanny, with reflective eyes and hair that seems to stir in still air.
Fine-boned and pale, with elegant hands and dark hair worn longer than local fashion allows.
Freckled and open-faced, with coppery hair, quick smiles, and the energetic posture of someone rarely still.
Grey-streaked hair and deep lines around the eyes, with hands still steady despite their age.
Narrow-shouldered and intent, with ink-smudged spectacles and hair repeatedly pushed back by stained fingers.
Lean and alert, with quick eyes and hands that look accustomed to fine work.
Massive in build but gentle in movement, with broad hands and a surprisingly soft expression.
Strongly built and weathered, with one clouded eye and the cautious balance of someone used to uneven ground.
Confidently dressed in layered fabrics, with bright metal ornaments and a posture that expects attention.
Pale from long hours indoors, with ink-smudged cuffs and eyes accustomed to lamplight.
Wrapped in patched layers of mismatched cloth, with curious tools hanging from every belt and strap.
Severe and composed, with close-cropped hair, a narrow face, and clothing chosen for discipline rather than comfort.
Round-faced and sturdy, with an open expression and sleeves often rolled to the elbow.
Hard-muscled and watchful, with an old scar crossing one cheek and a habit of standing where every doorway is visible.
Sharp-featured and restless, with hair tied back and the look of someone who sleeps lightly.
Silver-haired and upright despite advancing years, with clear skin and hands that remain remarkably steady.
Small and restless, with darting eyes, quick fingers, and pockets that seem to hold far more than they should.
Soft-featured and calm, with warm brown eyes and a face that seems familiar even to strangers.
Soot-darkened and muscular, with singed hair at the forearms and a permanent squint from years near open flame.
Otherwise unremarkable at a glance, except for unusually clear grey eyes that seem to notice everything.
Sun-freckled skin and wind-chapped lips, with boots that have been resoled more than once.
Tall and long-limbed, with a lantern jaw and clothes kept cleaner than their work would suggest.
Tall but slightly stooped, with long limbs and the patient movements of someone accustomed to cramped workspaces.
Lean and river-weathered, with faded blue tattoos winding from wrist to shoulder.
Compact and weathered, with cracked knuckles and a posture shaped by long outdoor labour.
Wind-burned and wiry, with salt-stiff hair and skin marked by years of bad weather.

distinctiveFeatures.text: A small black bird follows at a cautious distance and never seems to call.
A blackened iron key hangs from one ear as an earring.
A faded blue tattoo of an unknown constellation circles one wrist.
A braided beard threaded with tiny brass charms.
A badly burned palm usually hidden beneath a fingerless glove.
Heavily calloused palms and forearms marked by hot metal or rope.
Sleeves and cuffs are always dusted with coloured chalk.
A worn coin is constantly rolled across the knuckles.
A nose set slightly crooked from an old break that never quite healed straight.
A faint scent of dried herbs that clings to their clothes.
Breath fogs faintly even in a warm room.
A folding glass lens is carried in a polished brass case.
A glint of gold when they smile, conspicuous against otherwise plain dress.
One brown eye and one green, noticed only when they look directly at someone.
Ink-stained fingers that never quite wash clean.
One eye is dark brown and the other an unsettling pale green.
A missing fingertip on the left hand, long healed and rarely mentioned.
A neatly notched ear, old enough to pass for a forgotten shaving mishap.
An old arrowhead hangs on a cord at the throat.
Each fingernail is painted with a different tiny heraldic symbol.
A thumb-sized hourglass is checked at seemingly random moments.
A length of red thread is tied around one wrist and never removed.
A fine ritual scar along the forearm, partly hidden by rolled sleeves.
A single silver tooth that flashes whenever a smile escapes.
Singed eyebrows that suggest a recent and poorly explained accident.
Several tiny bells are sewn into the hem of the outer coat.
They seem to blink far less often than other people.
A thin scar crosses the throat where an old wound healed badly.
One hand is a beautifully carved wooden replacement fitted with practical metal joints.
A worn woven bracelet they touch when nervous.

personalities.text: Absent-minded about ordinary matters but intensely focused on chosen interests.
Polite, ambitious, and constantly measuring what every acquaintance might be worth.
Bitter about past failures but still unable to abandon old ideals.
Blunt to the point of rudeness, but rarely dishonest.
Blunt, loyal, and more comfortable with deeds than explanations.
Boisterous, generous, and incapable of speaking quietly when excited.
Calm, courteous, and faintly dangerous when contradicted.
Cheerfully fatalistic, convinced that worrying merely wastes good daylight.
Jovially competitive, turning almost any task into a friendly contest.
Dramatic and expressive, unable to describe even a simple errand without embellishment.
Dry, precise, and difficult to fluster.
Earnest and slightly naive, with complete faith that honesty will eventually win out.
Eccentric, inventive, and delighted by problems other people find alarming.
Guarded at first, but unexpectedly kind once trust is earned.
Methodical and calm, with little appetite for gossip unless it is useful.
Mournful in manner but gifted with a surprisingly sharp sense of humour.
Nervous in crowds but quick-witted when given a practical problem.
Patient and attentive, remembering small details others assume were forgotten.
Cheerful in public and sharper when they think no one important is listening.
Protective of neighbours and quick to involve themselves in local disputes.
Quietly devout, finding meaning in routine duties rather than grand declarations.
Restlessly curious, with a habit of turning conversations back to other people.
Stern but fair, with little patience for excuses and a strong dislike of bullies.
Superstitious in private and practical in public.
Suspicious of motives but unfailingly courteous in public.
Vain, charming, and always aware of who is watching.
Warm with strangers but quietly watchful.

mannerisms.text: Straightens nearby objects into neat rows while speaking.
Asks the date at unexpected moments and records the answer.
Steps carefully over thresholds rather than on them.
Glances toward exits and windows when entering a new room.
Chews a bitter-smelling leaf during long conversations.
Cleans spectacles that are already spotless whenever challenged.
Quietly counts coins or beads when thinking.
Cracks the knuckles before beginning any serious discussion.
Drums complex rhythms with the fingertips while waiting.
Folds scraps of paper into tiny animals while listening.
Hums under their breath while working.
Laughs a heartbeat later than everyone else.
Leans closer than necessary when sharing supposedly ordinary information.
Polishes the same small object whenever conversation becomes uncomfortable.
Answers awkward questions with half-remembered proverbs.
Repeats a person's name quietly after being introduced.
Rolls one shoulder as though easing an old injury.
Sniffs the air on entering a room, as if checking for smoke or rot.
Murmurs to horses, dogs, or pigeons as if they might answer.
Squints slightly when trying to recall a detail.
Chooses seats with a wall behind them whenever possible.
Straightens cups, papers, or tools without seeming to notice.
Taps the nearest flat surface once before answering a question.
Touches a charm at the throat before making a difficult decision.
Whispers brief encouragement to tools before using them.
Attempts conspiratorial winks that are impossible to mistake for subtlety.

voices.text: Has a booming, friendly voice that carries across crowded rooms.
Speaks breathlessly and with unsettling intensity.
Louder than necessary in crowds, then suddenly quiet in private.
Has a bright, youthful voice that rises whenever enthusiasm takes over.
Speaks in clipped, official phrases even during casual conversation.
Uses long dramatic pauses and clearly enjoys the effect.
Speaks in a flat, unreadable tone that gives away almost nothing.
Uses a gentle, reassuring tone that encourages people to keep talking.
Gravelly and direct, with little patience for evasion.
Hoarse but friendly, like someone used to shouting over wind or water.
Speaks with the hoarse rasp of someone accustomed to dust and cold nights.
Sounds perpetually amused, even when discussing serious matters.
Speaks in a low, measured voice.
Uses a melodic, formal cadence that makes ordinary remarks sound ceremonial.
A clipped, nasal tone that sounds permanently unimpressed.
Pronounces every word with careful academic precision.
Talks quickly, with a warm regional lilt.
Mutters rapidly through chains of thought before arriving at the answer.
Speaks with a resonant, prayerful cadence even outside formal worship.
Rarely raises the voice above a rough whisper.
Has a sharp, commanding voice that makes requests sound like orders.
Slow and deliberate, leaving long pauses that unsettle hurried listeners.
Speaks slowly in a broad rural accent, leaving long pauses for thought.
Uses soft, carefully chosen words, as if afraid of being overheard.

backgrounds.text: Completed most of a respectable apprenticeship, then fled after discovering something unsettling in their master's records.
Worked seasons as a caravan guard and learned more about people than about swordplay.
Comes from a well-known criminal family but has spent years trying to live beyond its reputation.
Escaped a secretive religious order and now avoids anyone displaying its symbols.
Lost a clerk's position after refusing to sign a document they knew was false.
Joined an adventuring company in youth but returned alone and refuses to discuss the final expedition.
Inherited a modest family trade and has kept it alive through stubborn competence rather than ambition.
Once accepted hospitality in a strange woodland court and returned to find several years had passed.
Spent several years moving forbidden goods across a difficult border before trying to settle honestly.
Was expelled from a respected guild for refusing an order that would have harmed innocent people.
Trained under a practical healer who treated anyone who could pay or bargain.
Was trapped briefly in a mine collapse and has refused deep tunnels ever since.
Spent several years in a monastery before returning to ordinary life with more questions than answers.
Lost a livelihood to a monster attack and rebuilt life around helping others avoid the same fate.
Was trained by a wandering mentor who disappeared after leaving behind a locked iron box.
Was born into a minor noble household and left after a public disgrace.
Once served in a border company and left after a mission went badly wrong.
Once served in a royal household and learned more than was ever intended.
Survived a shipwreck that killed several others and still dreams of the ones who did not come ashore.
Was the only survivor of a river or coastal wreck whose cause remains unexplained.
Raised among city back alleys and learned early which adults could be trusted.
Was raised by a small temple community and still measures time by its old bells.
Survived the destruction of a remote settlement and has never found anyone else from the same place.
Spent years travelling between libraries, monasteries, and ruined sites in search of a single missing text.
Fled a distant war with little more than a trade, a bundle of clothes, and one precious keepsake.

motivations.text: Make amends for a mistake that still haunts them in quiet moments.
Identify the person responsible for a friend's death without becoming consumed by revenge.
Complete a masterwork that will prove their skill beyond question.
Keep a dangerous creature hidden and contained until a permanent solution can be found.
Earn enough money to buy freedom from an employer, creditor, or binding contract.
Avoid fulfilling a prophecy that others seem determined to force upon them.
Gather enough proof to expose a corrupt local official without disappearing first.
Find out what happened to someone who vanished without explanation.
Keep their home and neighbours safe from trouble they understand but cannot ignore.
Earn enough to leave town cleanly, without owing favours to the wrong people.
Complete a reliable map of a place everyone else considers impossible to chart.
Settle an old debt before it ruins someone they care about.
Keep an old local tradition alive before the last people who remember it are gone.
Protect a young relative from inheriting a dangerous obligation.
Keep a younger relative from being pulled into the same dangerous work.
Prove a theory that respected scholars have publicly dismissed.
Repair a family division before illness or age makes reconciliation impossible.
Recover a stolen heirloom whose sentimental value far exceeds its price.
Restore a ruined professional reputation before age makes it permanent.
Restore a family or professional reputation damaged by an old scandal.
Make one final profitable deal and retire somewhere quiet.
Prove a story everyone dismisses is true before the evidence disappears.
Find a way to escape the consequences of a bargain made in desperation.

secrets.text: Is being blackmailed over a mistake that harmed no one but would destroy their reputation.
Bears a concealed mark belonging to a cult thought long destroyed.
Carries a cursed object that cannot be discarded for long.
Continues receiving letters from someone known to be dead.
Works for two rival factions and has nearly reached the point where both expect betrayal.
Escaped from lawful imprisonment after being convicted of a crime they did not commit.
Uses a false name because their real one would attract the wrong attention.
Can perform a small piece of forbidden magic and has hidden the talent for years.
Operates with a forged licence that would end their business if inspected.
Once robbed a grave and found something that should not have been there.
Hides a valuable heirloom that would be seized if discovered.
Knows of a hidden tunnel beneath the settlement and uses it for private errands.
Maintains a relationship that would cause scandal if exposed.
Feeds information to a local captain and pretends the arrangement is temporary.
Cannot remember an entire year of life and has started finding evidence of what happened during it.
Believes a feared local monster is a transformed relative and secretly leaves food for it.
Has a genuine claim to a minor title and wants absolutely nothing to do with it.
Privately worships a banned or forgotten deity.
Quietly passes messages for a smuggler in exchange for protection.
Built a respectable career using credentials stolen from someone who may still be alive.
Sells a few items of uncertain provenance when regular trade is slow.
Recognised a powerful criminal in passing and has never admitted it aloud.

problems.text: An ordinary object in their possession has been identified as a powerful relic.
Received a blackmail note with just enough detail to prove someone is watching.
A protective ward has begun failing for reasons no one can explain.
Unnatural weather follows their movements and is becoming harder to conceal.
Owes money to someone impatient and well connected.
A dangerous prisoner escaped using information that could only have come from inside.
Important memories are fading and written notes no longer match recollection.
A guild is demanding fees, loyalty, or silence that cannot be afforded.
The workplace shows unmistakable signs of being haunted after dark.
A valuable map has been lost just before an expedition is due to leave.
A expected shipment or payment has failed to arrive.
A trusted worker disappeared after claiming to have seen something beneath the building.
Fresh monster tracks have appeared nearby, but no one believes the warning.
A creditor has begun sending people to loiter outside their home.
A rival is spreading believable rumours that threaten to ruin their standing.
A rumour is spreading that makes ordinary customers avoid them.
Someone is quietly sabotaging their livelihood.
A key patron or relative is failing in health and cannot be moved safely.
A close relative is worsening from an illness local healers cannot identify.
A batch of stock, supplies, or tools has spoiled or broken at the worst possible time.
A ledger containing dangerous names and payments has been stolen.
Anonymous letters have begun arriving with details no stranger should know.
A recently buried body is not the person everyone believes it to be.

questHooks.text: Asks the party to watch their workplace for whoever is causing the trouble.
Believes a family curse has awakened and needs outsiders untouched by it.
Begs the party to speak to a magistrate or priest on their behalf before a hearing.
Needs a sealed message carried to someone who may refuse to receive it.
Needs a small but valuable delivery escorted through dangerous territory.
Needs escort while delivering a payment that cannot be trusted to normal guards.
Wants proof of an official's corruption gathered without alerting the watch.
Asks the party to find a relative who left town after an argument and never returned.
Wants help finding a missing worker whom the authorities have already dismissed as a runaway.
Needs discreet protection during a meeting with someone considered an enemy.
Needs help identifying an object that has begun changing overnight.
Believes someone in a crowded event stole something vital and asks the party to identify the thief.
Offers payment for quietly investigating noises beneath the cellar after closing time.
Offers to share rare maps if the party surveys a nearby ruin and returns with accurate notes.
Offers reliable local information if the party helps with a personal errand first.
Asks the party to discreetly protect a local festival from a threat that has not been made public.
Asks the party to recover a stolen ledger before its contents are sold.
Offers to pay for retrieval of a package left in the wrong hands.
Knows of a damaged seal beneath the settlement and needs capable people to inspect it.
Offers local guidance if the party agrees to track a creature preying on nearby livestock.
Claims to have witnessed something impossible near town and needs someone credible to investigate.

dangers.text: Their creditor has ties to violent people.
A local gang considers them useful property and may intervene if the party gets involved.
The promised reward is cursed or dangerously recognisable.
The person who hired them intends to betray everyone involved.
Helping them may draw attention from local authorities.
Helping them could make the party look complicit in an accusation already circulating.
A beloved family member is secretly involved on the wrong side.
A hidden cult has been monitoring the same events for much longer.
An innocent person is being used as leverage by those responsible.
The location itself is unstable and may collapse, flood, or burn.
A dangerous creature is already hunting anyone connected to the matter.
They are concealing one crucial fact that may put the party at risk.
Powerful officials have already arranged a convincing cover story.
The problem is part of an older curse that will not end with a simple victory.
Success may expose a scandal that damages people the party still needs.
A rival sellsword crew has been paid to ensure the matter stays unresolved.
Another adventuring group has accepted the opposite side of the job.
Their problem may have attracted something that does not care about city walls.
The situation will become much worse if it is not resolved before the next sunrise.
An unknown enemy already knows the party spoke with them.
Unstable magic is altering the area in unpredictable ways.
Several members of the local watch are involved in the problem.
